desc: 灰泥展台与暮青卧房，立卧式电蚊拍的安静夜用版式
name: 暖灰泥暮青立卧式电蚊拍款

shots.intent: 在详情首屏用两台同形机身一高一立于灰泥展台的干净剪影，一眼交代立卧式形态
shots.textZone: 顶部横排主标题与一行副题，右下角两枚空白方形索引标签位

shots.intent: 把夜里被打扰的三格语境摊成一排空镜框，让买家自己对号入座而不依赖任何虫体画面
shots.textZone: 左上两行痛点标题，三枚图框下方各一行空白括注标签

shots.intent: 用正侧机位把三层护网讲成分层结构，机制交给占位标签而不写任何电气事实
shots.textZone: 底部一行机制标题，右侧三枚空白方形索引标签

shots.intent: 用两栏同机位同尺度把立式与挂壁两种放置形态并排摊开，替买家完成二选一
shots.textZone: 左右卡内各一行标题与一行空白括注标签

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实夜用卧室语境，让买家在暮青客厅里代入自家角落
shots.textZone: 左上两行夜用标题，正文区不另放文字

shots.intent: 白昼玄关侧影把挂壁收纳讲成可见事实，与夜用屏形成明暗双场景节奏
shots.textZone: 左侧一行标题，下方一行括注标签含三枚空白方形索引位

shots.intent: 用掠射微距证明开关与指示点的做工与位置关系，质感撑住电气品类的信任
shots.textZone: 下方两枚空白方形索引标签，底部一行小标题

shots.intent: 一条横贯微距带把网丝交织点与护罩筋条拍成可触摸的工艺证据
shots.textZone: 带外底部一行小标题，带内不放文字

shots.intent: 以留白规格表与须知块的诚实版式做信任收口，真实数值一律由商家后期合成
shots.textZone: 四行参数右侧留空白值域，下方须知块留一行小标题与三行空白位

shots.intent: 把同一只机身的三种放置形态排成三格阵容，替买家解决放哪儿的最后一问
shots.textZone: 顶部一行标题，三格下方各一行空白括注标签

shots.intent: 用一条暮青压脚带把整页收在一个安静落点上，收口文案全部留给商家占位
shots.textZone: 上方一行收口标题，暮青带内一行结束标语，右上一枚空白方形索引位

style.backgroundSystem: matte plaster studio: an oat #F5F1E8 wall plane meeting a stone #E3DCCE step or plinth, one deep ink-teal #27423F dusk variant reserved for the two night screens, one cast window-blind shadow band as the only wall decoration, and square-cornered cards ruled with hairlines; never a cloud or sky gradient, never a water surface, never a botanical or floral field, never a black field
style.direction: quiet plaster-studio household pest-control tooling commerce
style.iconSystem: double-weight outline pictograms in warm charcoal #2C2A26 centred inside soft-cornered squares, each carrying one clay #C0724E dot marker; hairline callout rules ending in small open circles; no filled circular medallions, no bubbles, no waves, no insect or animal drawings
style.lightingSystem: low warm-neutral key from camera right at about 4700K raking across the planes with a cool ambient bounce from camera left, long soft directional shadows falling to the left, medium contrast with protected highlights, one true contact shadow under every standing or hung unit, matte plastic rendered without hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet plaster-studio household pest-control tooling commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of oat plaster #F5F1E8, stone #E3DCCE and one deep ink-teal dusk field #27423F, with a single clay accent #C0724E and warm charcoal text #2C2A26; neutral colour temperature throughout; background system limited to a matte plaster wall plane meeting a stone step or plinth, one ink-teal #27423F dusk variant reserved for the two night screens, one cast window-blind shadow band as the only wall decoration, and square-cornered cards ruled with hairlines, never a cloud or sky gradient and never a water surface; low warm-neutral key light from camera right at about 4700K raking across the planes with a cool ambient bounce from camera left, long soft directional shadows falling to the left, medium contrast, protected highlights, one true contact shadow under every standing or hung unit; surfaces limited to cast plaster, a shallow plaster cradle, warm-grey micro-cement #C6C0B6, pale oak #CBB69A, jute #B9A98E and a linen #E7E0D2 throw; modern grotesque sans-serif with tight tracking, one short Chinese headline per screen in 「」 at 26-42pt in warm charcoal #2C2A26 set as horizontal blocks, plus straight hairline rules, small square index tabs and bracketed label rows; double-weight outline pictograms inside soft-cornered squares with one clay #C0724E dot marker and hairline callout rules ending in small open circles; the racket keeps its oval head frame #A2AFB9, three concentric outer protective arcs, inner mesh layer #F4F6F8, handle #F2F3F5 with one slide switch above two unlit indicator dots #2A2F33, its flared standing foot and its moulded back marking kept as a blank embossed field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cloud-sky or water motifs, no botanical sprigs, no bubbles, no pill badges, no wavy divider bands, no invented numbers or claims.
noDrift: no voltage, wattage, amperage, current, '强电压' or '无辐射' wording anywhere; every power fact removed to a blank field
no battery capacity, milliampere figure, charge-hour, runtime-hour or standby-duration claim, no hours of any kind
no decibel or noise-level figure and no quietness comparison row
no coverage area, effective radius, room size, metre or centimetre value, and no dimension arrow or measurement line drawn on the product
no kill rate, efficacy percentage, capture count, species name or insect illustration of any kind
no non-toxic, harmless, food-grade, maternal-infant-safe, baby-proof or '无毒无害母婴适用' assertion in any slot
no health, disease-prevention or epidemiological wording, no medical or clinical visual
no certification, test report, licence, award, trademark, star grade, sales figure, price, discount, coupon, shipping promise, QR code or membership badge
never a hand, finger, foot or any body part on or inside the mesh; never a child, infant or unsupervised minor in frame
never striking, spraying or operating the unit at water, wet hands, insects on skin, or near curtains, paper, alcohol or any flammable surface
in every structural or internal view the mesh stays intact, dry and clearly de-energised: no arc, spark, bolt, glow or smoke
any person is anonymous and cropped above the jaw or below the shoulder, turned away, and never holding the unit
no brand lettering, no latin filler copy, no decorative english placeholder lines, no redrawn marking on the handle
no cloud-sky field, water splash arc, eucalyptus or botanical sprig, bubble medallion, pill badge or wavy divider band
no palette drift, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent light direction, no unit floating without a contact shadow, no clipped base
style.presentationRules: the unit keeps its oval head frame #A2AFB9, its three concentric outer protective arcs, the inner mesh layer #F4F6F8, the handle #F2F3F5 with one slide switch placed above two unlit indicator dots #2A2F33, its flared handle foot that lets it stand unaided, and the moulded back marking kept as a blank embossed field; head shape, mesh layering, handle profile, switch and dot placement, stand form and colourway unchanged; the unit stands, leans or hangs only on a surface that plausibly carries its weight, and no body part is ever on or inside the mesh
style.surfaceSystem: cast plaster blocks and a low stone #E3DCCE step, a shallow plaster cradle supporting a standing unit, warm-grey micro-cement #C6C0B6 floor in the dusk screens, a pale oak #CBB69A ledge and a jute #B9A98E runner in the living-room screen, a linen #E7E0D2 throw as the only textile
style.typography: modern grotesque sans-serif with tight tracking, one short Chinese headline per screen wrapped in 「」 at 26-42pt in warm charcoal #2C2A26, set as horizontal blocks, plus straight hairline rules, small square index tabs and bracketed label rows; no pills, no bubbles, no wavy bands, no vertical headline stacks, no dense body paragraphs
